clauses.quote: Establish a 125 plan (Flexible Spending Account) for premiums, out-of-pocket medical costs, and child care expenses.
clauses.notes: Implied subject 'District' from collective bargaining agreement listing conventions.

clauses.quote: This plan will include a charge to employees for dependent care or unreimbursed medical expenses of $4 per month for one option and $6 per month for both options (no charge for premium).
Establish a procedure whereby employees can elect not to be covered by one or more benefit programs.
clauses.notes: Implied subject 'District'. Grants workers the permission/option to opt out.

clauses.quote: Deduct $5 tenthly from each employee electing medical benefit coverage.
This payment will be waived for retirees enrolled in the Kaiser Senior Advantage/Health Net Seniority Plus plans.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit agent is District. Waiver protects worker retirees.

clauses.quote: Deduct $40 tenthly from each employee electing medical benefit coverage for spouse or spouse and eligible dependents.
This payment will be waived for retirees enrolled in the Kaiser Senior Advantage/Health Net Seniority Plus plans.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit agent is District. Waiver protects worker retirees.

clauses.quote: In cases where an employee and spouse are both employees of the District, each shall have the deduction of $5 tenthly in order to receive medical benefits;
clauses.notes: Clause joined by semicolon to following text; extracted separately.

clauses.quote: however, only one shall have to elect the $40 spousal deduction for their benefits to be fully coordinated under the Group Health Plan.
clauses.notes: Clause joined by semicolon; limits worker duty to prevent double deduction.

clauses.quote: Deduct $10 tenthly from each employee electing medical benefit coverage for eligible dependents other than spouse.
For the Group Health Plan, the deductible is $200 per covered person, with a $400 family maximum.

For the Group Health Plan, for employees hired after the effective date of the Agreement, deny coverage for pre-existing conditions until the first of the month following the completion of one year of employment.
clauses.notes: Implied subject 'District'. Restricts district's ability to cover pre-existing conditions.

clauses.quote: HIPA certification will waive the pre-existing condition(s).
clauses.notes: Condition triggers district waiver, ultimately benefiting worker.

clauses.quote: For the Group Health Plan, the coinsurance maximum is $7,500.
